1️ Add spdlog as a Git Submodule
Bash

Code kopieren
# From your project root
git submodule add https://github.com/gabime/spdlog.git external/spdlog
git submodule update --init --recursive
This will place spdlog in external/spdlog.

2️ Premake Integration (Header-Only Mode — simplest)
Since spdlog is header-only by default, you just need to add its include directory to your project.

premake5.lua

Lua

Code kopieren
workspace "MyProject"
    configurations { "Debug", "Release" }
    architecture "x86_64"
    startproject "App"

project "App"
    kind "ConsoleApp"
    language "C++"
    cppdialect "C++17"
    targetdir "bin/%{cfg.buildcfg}"
    objdir "bin-int/%{cfg.buildcfg}"

    files {
        "src/**.h",
        "src/**.cpp"
    }

    -- Include spdlog headers
    includedirs {
        "external/spdlog/include"
    }

    filter "configurations:Debug"
        symbols "On"

    filter "configurations:Release"
        optimize "On"
Pros: No extra build step, easiest setup.
Cons: Slightly slower compile times for large projects.

3️ Premake Integration (Compiled Library Mode — faster builds)
If you want to compile spdlog as a static library for faster incremental builds:

premake5.lua

Lua

Code kopieren
workspace "MyProject"
    configurations { "Debug", "Release" }
    architecture "x86_64"
    startproject "App"

-- spdlog static library project
project "spdlog"
    kind "StaticLib"
    language "C++"
    cppdialect "C++17"
    targetdir "bin/%{cfg.buildcfg}"
    objdir "bin-int/%{cfg.buildcfg}"

    files {
        "external/spdlog/src/**.cpp"
    }

    includedirs {
        "external/spdlog/include"
    }

-- Your main app
project "App"
    kind "ConsoleApp"
    language "C++"
    cppdialect "C++17"
    targetdir "bin/%{cfg.buildcfg}"
    objdir "bin-int/%{cfg.buildcfg}"

    files {
        "src/**.h",
        "src/**.cpp"
    }

    includedirs {
        "external/spdlog/include"
    }

    links { "spdlog" }

    filter "configurations:Debug"
        symbols "On"

    filter "configurations:Release"
        optimize "On"

4️ Example Usage
src/main.cpp

Cpp

Code kopieren
#include "spdlog/spdlog.h"

int main() {
    spdlog::info("Hello from spdlog!");
    spdlog::warn("This is a warning with number: {}", 42);
    return 0;
}

5️ Build
Bash

Code kopieren
premake5 gmake2   # or vs2022, xcode4, etc.
make config=release
